mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_biz_file_task (task_type, file_id, payload_json, state, attempts, last_error, creator, updater) VALUES (#{taskType}, #{fileId}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS jsonb), #{state}, #{attempts}, #{lastError}, #{creator}, #{updater})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type, file_id, payload_json, state, attempts, last_error, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted FROM public.nocode_biz_file_task WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 0 AND state <> 'DONE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, task_type, file_id, payload_json, state, attempts, last_error, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted FROM public.nocode_biz_file_task WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND deleted = 0 AND state <> 'DONE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_biz_upload_session s WHERE s.file_id = nocode_biz_file_task.file_id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.state <> 'CLEANED' ) ORDER BY update_time, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_biz_file_task SET state = 'FAILED', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, updater = #{actor}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
